createMenu.guidedPrompt: Help me create a new skill. Ask me the questions you need one at a time: What should the skill be for? In which situations should it kick in? What should it pay attention to, what should it avoid? Whatever you can already derive from my answers, propose it instead of asking. Once the picture is complete, create the skill with a name, a short description and instructions.

improve.tooltip: Improve this text with Ayunis Core
improve.needsInput: Write a few words first, then Ayunis Core has something to work with.
improve.error: The text could not be improved. Please try again.
improve.emptyAnswer: No suggestion came back. Your text is unchanged.
improve.noModel: No model is enabled for your organisation.
improve.anonymousOnly: Ayunis Core can't improve this text because every enabled model may only receive anonymised input.
improve.limitReached: You have reached your usage limit. Your text is unchanged.

fieldHints.trigger: The trigger decides when this skill switches itself on. Describe the situation as concretely as you can: which topics are involved, which words come up, which questions get asked. Example: "When a building application deadline comes up or someone asks for a cut-off date."
fieldHints.instructions: The instructions describe how to work once the skill is active: the approach, the tone, how the answer is structured and what to leave out. Example: "Answer factually in full sentences, always name the legal basis, and ask back when the file number is missing."

starter.title: What do you do again and again?
starter.description: Describe it in one sentence. Ayunis Core asks a few questions and creates the skill for you.
starter.placeholder: For example: answering enquiries about building permits
starter.topicSuffix: The skill should help me with this: {{topic}}
